rationale.edition: All six changed paths live under OSS-owned locations: src/api/management, src/config, src/core, src/infra, and web/src. None are under enterprise/, o2_enterprise/, or src/enterprise/, and no enterprise keyword (cipher/SSO/SAML/RBAC/SDR/sensitive-data/logo-management) appears in the paths or symbols, so this is an OSS change.
rationale.skip: Not skipped. The diff includes a user-facing frontend change (web/src/components/alerts/composite/CompositeAlertForm.vue) and no explicit opt-out (no tests-added label and an empty trigger comment), so the no-user-facing-change skip does not apply.
rationale.e2e: E2E is warranted. The composite alert list now populates last_triggered_at and last_satisfied_at (previously hardcoded None), and the composite alert form now surfaces the real validation error message instead of a generic code — both are user-exercisable UI/behavior changes a Playwright spec can verify.
rationale.area: The bulk of the user-facing change is in web/src/components/alerts/composite/CompositeAlertForm.vue and the related alert list API, and an existing tests/ui-testing/playwright-tests/Alerts folder with sibling alerts-*.spec.js specs is the natural home.
rationale.group: The Alerts shard (actual_folder Alerts) already groups alerts-e2e-flow.spec.js, alerts-ui-operations.spec.js, alerts-advanced.spec.js and related alert specs, so the new composite-alert spec joins that existing group.
rationale.existing_tests: No E2E specs in the diff. The changed files are Rust backend sources and one Vue component; no files under tests/ui-testing/playwright-tests/ were modified, so there is no existing Playwright coverage for this feature.
